fields.statement: At 95a41720 ran go test -count=1 -v ./internal/machine: TestAbsentIsDaily, TestTrustValues, TestHomeDefault, TestBadFilesNameThePath, TestPathUnknown all PASS. Read the diff: Path uses $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/machine.toml when set, else ~/.config/rhiza/machine.toml; Read returns daily for an absent file, accepts trust = "dedicated" and "daily", and errors naming the path for non-TOML input and for trust = "root". The tests cover no file -> daily, both trust values via XDG_CONFIG_HOME, dedicated via the ~/.config default, and both bad files with the path in the error. make check passed fmt-check, vet and go test ./...; self-check failed only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor/index files, which is expected before render on landing.
